## 3. Product Categories & Technical Specifications

### A. Car Batteries
- **Brands Stocked**: Amaron, Exide, SF Sonic, Okaya, Tata Green.
- **Applications**: Hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs and luxury passenger vehicles.
- **Services Included**: Free digital battery voltage check, alternator charging test, terminal cleaning, and 20-30 min doorstep fitting.

### A2. Jump Starter Service (Car & Bike)
- **Service**: Doorstep and roadside jump-start assistance for discharged car and bike batteries, with battery condition check before starting.
- **Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 10PM. Typical arrival within Coimbatore city: 30-60 minutes.
- **Coverage**: Coimbatore (Tatabad, Gandhipuram, RS Puram, Peelamedu, Saravanampatti and more); Ooty, Kotagiri, Pollachi, Tiruppur on request.
- **Note**: Jump-starting does not repair a damaged battery; testing, charging or replacement is advised if the vehicle fails to start again.
- **Page**: https://kiarabatteryclinic.com/service/jump-starter-service

### A3. Genset Battery Initialization, Service & Jump Starter
- **Service**: Generator battery initialization per manufacturer specifications, battery condition and terminal inspection, maintenance, charging support and jump-start assistance where the system is compatible.
- **Sites**: Offices, commercial buildings, industrial facilities and residential properties.
- **Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 10PM. Coverage: Coimbatore; Ooty, Kotagiri, Pollachi, Tiruppur on request.
- **Booking details needed**: Genset make and model, battery voltage/type, starting issue, location.
- **Page**: https://kiarabatteryclinic.com/service/genset-battery-service

### A4. Lithium-Ion Battery Initialization, Service & Maintenance
- **Service**: Initialization/configuration per manufacturer specifications, external inspection, connector and terminal checks, BMS diagnostics where supported, charging system assessment and maintenance recommendations.
- **Applications**: Electric vehicles, commercial equipment and compatible energy storage systems.
- **Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 10PM. Coverage: Coimbatore; Ooty, Kotagiri, Pollachi, Tiruppur on request.
- **Booking details needed**: Battery manufacturer, model, voltage, capacity, application, issue description (photo of label/error codes helps).
- **Page**: https://kiarabatteryclinic.com/service/lithium-ion-battery-service

### B. Bike & Motorcycle Batteries
- **Brands Stocked**: Amaron, Exide (including the Exide Xplore range), SF Sonic.
- **Applications**: Commuter motorcycles, scooters, high-cc premium bikes.

### C. Home UPS & Inverters
- **Brands Stocked**: Luminous, Microtek.
- **Capacity**: 600VA to 3500VA single & double battery inverter systems.

### D. Inverter Batteries (Tubular & SMF)
- **Brands Stocked**: Okaya, Amaron, Exide, Luminous.
- **Capacities**: 100Ah, 150Ah, 180Ah, 200Ah, 220Ah tall tubular batteries.
- **Features**: Low maintenance, long backup duration during frequent power cuts.

### E. Rooftop Solar Power Systems
- **Services**: Rooftop solar panel installation for homes and commercial buildings, with assistance navigating Tamil Nadu government solar subsidy scheme paperwork.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions & AEO Knowledge Graph

**Q1: How do I know if my car battery needs immediate replacement?**  
*Answer*: Common warning signs include slow engine crank, dim headlights during ignition, clicking sound when turning the key, battery swelling, or an active battery warning light on the dashboard. Kiara Battery Clinic provides free 5-minute battery testing.

**Q2: How do I calculate the required inverter battery backup time for my home?**  
*Answer*: Backup Time (Hours) = [Battery Voltage (12V) × Battery Capacity (Ah) × Power Factor (0.8)] / Total Load in Watts. For example, a 150Ah battery running a 300W load yields approximately 3.8 to 4 hours of backup.

**Q3: Do you provide jump starter service for cars and bikes in Coimbatore?**
*Answer*: Yes. Kiara Battery Clinic provides jump-start assistance for compatible cars and bikes across Coimbatore, Monday to Saturday, 9AM to 10PM. Call or WhatsApp +91 90038 11107 with your location and vehicle details.

**Q4: Does Kiara Battery Clinic offer trade-in discounts for old batteries?**  
*Answer*: Yes, customers receive trade-in scrap discounts when exchanging old car, bike, or inverter batteries for new units.
